note: Adapted from Constantino's (1995) revision, originally in English. The alate, the soldier and the major worker are described. Soldier measurements: 10 colonies, 10 individuals, head length 5.10—5.90 mm, maximum head width 5.10—5.80 mm, head height without postmentum 2.80—3.10 mm, frontal tube length 0.15—0.25 mm, left mandible length 2.80—3.00 mm, curvature 0.80—1.10 mm; the original also lists measurements for 1 colony of 3 soldiers (head length 4.45—4.80 mm, maximum head width 3.90—4.30 mm, head height without postmentum 2.30—2.55 mm, frontal tube length 0.17—0.22 mm, left mandible length 2.70—2.85 mm, curvature 0.80—0.95 mm), showing marked size differences between colonies.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate like S. peruanus but larger; also superficially similar to S. molestus and S. magnoculus, but the latter two are usually larger, with proportionally larger compound eyes. Soldier similar to S. grandis and sometimes difficult to distinguish: this species is smaller, the sides of the head more parallel, the mandibles straighter with smaller marginal teeth, and the head with more hairs.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes of medium size, larger than 1/4 of the head width; ocelli small; fontanelle slightly elongated, sometimes nearly triangular. Antennae 20-segmented. Anterior corners of the pronotum…… (the original continues on the next page).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short, head length and width nearly equal; the sides slightly converging anteriorly or nearly parallel; posterior margin of the head round. Frontal tube very short, the opening clearly visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width nearly equal; lateral corners about right-angled; median lobe short. Antennae 19—20-segmented. Postmentum constricted near the middle.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head capsule and postclypeus densely covered with short straight setae; fontanelle slightly elongated and of medium size. Antennae 19—20-segmented. Thoracic spines weak. Mandibles very similar to those of S. grandis, the molar plate wide. Hindgut very large, the 1st and 3rd hindgut segments strongly inflated; main midgut extension of the mixed segment……
